_comment: El Gerwany brand. Values follow creative direction Option A (recommended, NOT yet approved). Colors are PROVISIONAL until re-anchored to the supplied logo. Nothing is inherited from Sanad (see brand/creative-direction.md anti-clone table).

logo.mark: derive only if the supplied logo has a separable mark; never redraw

colors._status: PROVISIONAL — Option A, re-anchor to logo
colors._contrast: Checked WCAG 2.2: text/primary/muted/semantic all ≥ 4.5:1. Accent #E4602A is 3.5:1 on white → use only as fill with ink text (5.07:1) or large text; small accent text uses accent_text #B4461B (5.48:1). surface.line #D9DFEA is decorative only; form-field borders use input_border #7C879C (3.62:1 on white, 3.32:1 on background).

typography.heading_font: IBM Plex Sans Arabic / IBM Plex Sans
typography.body_font: IBM Plex Sans Arabic / IBM Plex Sans

visual_style.photography_style: real documentary photos of team and work; cool-neutral grade; no stock
visual_style.illustration_style: none (optional minimal line diagrams of process steps)
visual_style.shadow_style: flat — hairline borders instead of shadows

three_d_and_video.video_motion_graphics: none at launch; optional documentary loop if footage supplied
